name: provider-switch
description: Switch the API provider of a running Claude Code session with no restart. Depends on cc-switch: reads the provider list already configured there, applies the chosen env live, and records the choice per session.

nodeBin.title: Node binary
nodeBin.description: Node 22.5+ (for node:sqlite). Empty uses node on PATH.

switchModel.title: Switch the model too
switchModel.description: After switching provider, run /model with the model the provider names. Claude Code records it as the default for new sessions; turn this off to leave the model alone.
